text: Maintaining a healthy lifestyle involves more than just eating well. A balanced diet, rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, gives your body the fuel it needs. However, regular exercise is equally important. Even a daily thirty-minute walk can boost your heart health and energy levels. But don't forget about rest; getting seven to eight hours of quality sleep is vital for both physical recovery and your mental health, helping to reduce stress. Finally, to truly thrive, you need a work-life balance. Make time for hobbies and socialising, and learn to switch off from work. This can lower anxiety and lead to a happier, more fulfilling life.
